name: 女士修身长袖纽扣衬衫款

shots.intent: 搜索列表一眼点击：正面全身廓形干净呈现，占据首图位。
一秒讲清核心利益：腰线与省道带来的修身轮廓。
用背面结构解释工艺，打消版型与做工疑虑。
横版信息图承接三条卖点，图内文字全部留空交给后期。
四格同光微距证明面料织纹与车线纽扣的做工。
俯拍平铺收口：以工整折叠与空白规格条建立可信交付印象。

style.backgroundSystem: seamless pure white #FFFFFF packshots alternating with a matte pale mist panel #EEF2F6 for benefit and infographic screens
style.iconSystem: thin single-weight line icons in cool grey-blue #7C9AB5, kept as empty slots in template
style.lightingSystem: bright even high-key studio light, front-left softbox key with fill, 5500K, low-contrast soft contact shadow, sweeping side light skimming the fabric to read seams
style.lockText: Campaign Style Lock: consistent premium womenswear tailoring visual system across the entire image set; fixed palette of seamless pure white background #FFFFFF, matte pale mist panel #EEF2F6, deep charcoal rules #2D2D2D and one cool grey-blue accent #7C9AB5; bright even high-key studio lighting at 5500K with a front-left key, soft fill and a sweeping side light skimming the fabric, soft contact shadows only; modern geometric sans-serif with thin single-weight line icons; garments presented on a headless invisible-mannequin form or in a symmetric flat lay; stable garment scale and placket facing; no color palette changes, no mixed fonts, no random backgrounds, no inconsistent lighting, no mismatched icon styles, no model identity.
noDrift: no random textured backgrounds or lifestyle props
no inconsistent lighting or hard speculars
no visible model identity, head or hands
no filled spec numbers or badge artwork
style.presentationRules: garment always shown on a headless invisible-mannequin form or flat lay, consistent button-placket facing, stable scale, symmetrical sleeve spacing, no face and no limbs
style.surfaceSystem: matte pale mist board #EEF2F6 and seamless white sweep #FFFFFF, no textured props, no wood or stone
style.typography: modern geometric sans-serif, thin charcoal rules, all rendered copy left to post-production
